changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0042. Tenant business configuration: one operational config row per gym, member categories, discount rules, and CRM source/lost-reason catalogs. Index review: UX_TenantBusinessConfigs_TenantId enforces one config per tenant; UX_MemberCategories_TenantId_Name and UX_DiscountRules_TenantId_Name keep names unique; IX_DiscountRules_TenantId_IsActive serves active discount lists; UX_CrmLeadSources_TenantId_Name and UX_CrmLostReasons_TenantId_Name keep CRM catalogs unique. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId.

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0043. Enable GYM_CONFIGURATION on business plans and grant configuration permissions to owner and manager. Index review: catalog inserts only. Performance note: fixed permission set.
